facts.text: The hotel is rooted in the Villard Mansion, built by Henry Villard in Italian Renaissance Revival style and designed by McKim, Mead & White.
facts.excerpt: Built in 1882 by Henry Villard, the mansion is a masterpiece of Italian Renaissance Revival architecture, designed by the esteemed firm McKim, Mead & White.

facts.text: The Palace Historian leads a one-hour guided tour of the Villard Mansion, one of New York City's few surviving Gilded Age mansions.
facts.excerpt: Join our Palace Historian for a one-hour guided tour of our Villard Mansion, one of New York City’s few surviving Gilded Age mansions.

facts.text: The Gilded Age history tour is complimentary to guests and gathers in the Grand Lobby.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary to guests. Please visit the concierge to sign up. Tours gather in the Grand Lobby.

facts.text: The Towers comprises guest rooms and suites on the hotel's top 14 floors.
facts.excerpt: extra-spacious suites on the hotel’s top 14 floors

facts.text: The Towers has a private lobby and check-in and maitre d'etage butler service.
facts.excerpt:
- Private lobby and check-in
- Maître d'etage butler service

facts.text: The Royal Suite Collection suites range from 2,500 to 5,000 square feet with panoramic skyline views.
facts.excerpt: this premier collection ranges from 2,500 to 5,000 square feet and features glamorous living spaces framed by panoramic skyline views.

facts.text: The Jewel Suite, created with jewelry designer Martin Katz, is a triplex with a two-story crystal chandelier and a terrace-level hideaway with a wood-burning fireplace.
facts.excerpt: A two-story crystal chandelier sets the tone for this glamorous suite, which also features a mirrored dining room with seating for ten and a terrace-level hideaway with a wood-burning fireplace inside

facts.text: The Champagne Suite spans three floors, with a two-story marble parlor, a wine cave and a rooftop terrace with a custom waterfall spa.
facts.excerpt: the Champagne Suite spans three floors and features a grand two-story marble parlor adorned with a mural by French artists Alex et Marine, a formal dining room seating ten, and a wine cave.

facts.text: Cathedral View rooms look out on St. Patrick's Cathedral and Rockefeller Center.
facts.excerpt: Our elegantly furnished Cathedral Room has views of the iconic St. Patrick's Cathedral and Rockefeller Center.

facts.text: The hotel's St. Patrick's Cathedral VIP tour includes the lower halls and staircases, the main altar, the bishop's crypt and the choir loft.
facts.excerpt: The tour includes the lower labyrinth of halls and staircases, the main altar, the bishop's crypt, the choir loft, and the heart of the cathedral.

facts.text: The hotel has a spa called ila at Lotte New York Palace.
facts.excerpt: ila only Spa at Lotte New York Palace

facts.text: MITANI New York is the newest outpost of Tokyo's Sushi Mitani.
facts.excerpt: Proudly introducing MITANI New York, the newest outpost of Tokyo’s esteemed Sushi Mitani

facts.text: Rarities is an intimate salon for rare wines, spirits and champagnes.
facts.excerpt: An intimate salon for connoisseurs of rare wines, spirits and champagnes.

facts.text: Rockefeller Center and MoMA are among the Midtown sights near the hotel.
facts.excerpt: From Rockefeller Center to MoMA, the best of Midtown Manhattan is at your doorstep.

facts.text: The concierge team are Les Clefs d'Or concierges.
facts.excerpt: Our dedicated team of Les Clefs d'Or concierge is here to help you find

facts.text: The Little Royals package includes Towers accommodation, an in-room Palace playhouse and Pomme Palais cupcakes delivered to the room.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy luxurious accommodations in The Towers, complete with a Palace playhouse fit for royalty

facts.text: FAO Schwarz's flagship store is two blocks from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: FAO Schwarz’s flagship store (located just two blocks from The Palace)

facts.text: The hotel's famous holiday decor returns on November 23, 2026, transforming the courtyard and lobby.
facts.excerpt: Beginning November 23, the Palace’s renowned holiday display transforms the iconic courtyard and lobby.

facts.text: The hotel has 30,000 square feet of event space.
facts.excerpt: With 30,000 square feet of event space and seamless service

facts.text: Bergdorf Goodman is less than a ten-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Less than a ten minute walk from the hotel is landmark department store Bergdorf Goodman

facts.text: Steve Cohen's Chamber Magic performs each Friday and Saturday evening in the hotel's Madison Room.
facts.excerpt: Be dazzled by the "Millionaire's Magician" each Friday and Saturday evening in our Madison Room.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself New York City's most iconic and instantly recognizable hotel.
facts.excerpt: has long reigned as New York City’s most iconic and instantly recognizable hotel

facts.text: The hotel calls the Royal Suite Collection Manhattan's largest hotel suites.
facts.excerpt: Manhattan’s largest hotel suites

facts.text: The full fee for the St. Patrick's Cathedral VIP tour is donated to the cathedral.
facts.excerpt: 100% of the tour fee is donated to St. Patrick’s Cathedral.

facts.text: Higher-floor Skyline Cathedral View rooms look toward Manhattan's West Side, Rockefeller Center and St. Patrick's Cathedral.
facts.excerpt: Located on higher floors, our Cathedral View High Floor Rooms offer panoramic skyline views of Manhattan’s West Side, Rockefeller Center, and St. Patrick’s Cathedral.
